case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your proposal and your continued trust in our foundry. It is always a pleasure to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, a valued partner with whom we share a long and cherished relationship. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are open to extending the contract duration to 24 months and accommodating your request for a 60-day payment term. However, to maintain the high quality and reliability you expect from us, we can offer a price of €51.60 under these extended terms. 

To summarize our offer, we propose a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised proposal and value our continued partnership. As we have already accommodated your requests for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms, our flexibility on price is limited. However, in the spirit of our long-standing relationship, we can make a further concession to €51.40 per unit.

For our Angebot, we present a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a privilege to work together with your respected firm, and our team here in the foundry takes immense pride in delivering the highest quality castings for your pumps. We trust this refined proposal reflects both our deep dedication to your success and the practical realities of our craft.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised proposal and the constructive dialogue between our companies. It is always a pleasure to work together with trusted partners who value quality craftsmanship. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.20 per unit for the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.

Our full Angebot is a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please bear in mind that we have already accommodated your requests for extended payment and contract terms, which restricts our ability to make large price concessions.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued movement and the constructive dialogue between our companies. Over many years of close cooperation, our foundry has taken great pride in delivering reliable quality to your team. In response, we are prepared to make a further concession to a price of €51.00 per unit for the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Please understand that we are reaching the limits of our flexibility under these extended terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days. We hope to continue our good partnership and look forward to your decision.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
